Ducklett

Water Flying

Unova · Generation 5

Ducklett is a Water/Flying-type Water Bird Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 5.5 kg. It evolves into Swanna. Its highest base stat is HP (62), with a base stat total of 305.
